page.overview:
Who is Tettsel Anker?

Tettsel Anker was a female Zabrak Chirq Council sub-councilor who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Tettsel Anker was a member of the criminal organization known as the Chirq Council. After the Battle of Yavin, sub-councilors Tettsel Anker and Dain Pax were trained in the Second Elite Council Bunker, near the city of Doaba Guerfel, in order to start new Chirq Council chapters in Bela Vistal and Vreni Island.

In 1 ABY, Captain Vitala Baize successfully infiltrated a CorSec agent within the organization. Assuming the identity of the Chirq Council member Trins Evnar, the CorSec agent managed to infiltrate Jzoro Quanera's Chirq Council chapter in Doaba Guerfel. From Jzoro Quanera's database, the CorSec obtained the identity of the nine elite councilors and the locations of their secret headquarters. The CorSec later assaulted the First and the Second Elite Council Bunkers. During the raid on the Second Elite Council Bunker, Agent Chun Solso was tasked to prevent Tettsel Anker and Dain Pax's attempt to extend the reach of the Chirq Council in Bela Vistal and Vreni Island. Agent Solso thus hired an independent spacer who previously worked for the CorSec to help him in his mission. The spacer fought and managed to kill the two sub-councilors. Eventually, the Chirq Council splintered after the Chirq Council elite councilors were killed by the CorSec in the Elite Council Bunkers.

Tettsel Anker was a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Tettsel Anker was added to the game with the update named "Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives," published on June 8, 2006.
